Name: Upgraded Casks
Author: zhanx1224
Description:
Add new casks with large storage. Up to 320 wine can be placed in one new cask now.

Compared with vanilla casks, the quantity of ingredients and products are both multiplied by:
[list]
[*]Copper Cask - 5x
[*]Iron Cask - 20x
[*]Gold Cask - 80x
[*]Iridium Cask - 320x
[/list]
Recipe of one cask = Wood*20 + Hardwood*5 + (this kind of metal bar)*5

[b]Attention
[/b][list]
[*](New) Unlike the vanilla ones these casks can't return the things inside unless the processing is done. If you use the axe/pickaxe on an upgraded cask, items inside will [b]disappear[/b].
[*]Can work outside cellar.
[*]Count 1 SDV day as 1200 min. So new casks work slightly faster than vanilla casks. But it's still not fast at all, honestly.
[*]Wine or cheeses gain one quality level from every process. You have to harvest them and re-place into casks if you want higher quality. But [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]CFAutomate[/url] (in the Files tab of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]) will do this for you. To obtain iridium-quality products, things to do are to place a chest next to the cask, throw wine or cheeses into the chest, and wait and wait and wait.
[/list]
[b]Existing Problem[/b]
This problem only occurs to wine. After process wine will be added 2 spaces "  " to the end of its name. For example you will transform some normal "Starfruit Wine" to iridium-quality "Starfruit Wine      " after 3 processes. If you read the JSON Format in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url], and find a solution to retain the original wine name, please let me know I'll be glad to fix it!

[b]Installation[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url] is required. For CFR v2.9.10 or later, just extract mods into "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder.

[b]ChangeLog
[/b]v1.1.0: Pale ales now work with upgraded casks.
